description: Every Reactor contribution point of this protocol's plugin, in both languages (AGENT_PROTOCOLS §3.1). test_protocols_reactor_points.py and src/protocols/reactorPoints.unit.test.ts hold each language to this file. A point whose `extension` is true is an extension the protocol defines; its contributions are implementations of it. `default` is the contribution id of the plugin's own default (order 100), null when a host must contribute one. `resolution` is `single` (the lowest order answers; two at the same order fail closed) or `all` (every contribution is used).
note: No point yet: MCP's optional capabilities and extensions become mcp.extension.<name> when agent_runtimes.mcp reads them from contributions (PR-01).
